description: Mercury in houses 1-12 from Vol II, paraphrased. Same row schema as planet_house.json.

rows.theme: A ruler type, self-willed and mischievous; Saturn leads, Rahu-Ketu follow.

conditions.effect: Mercurial, independent temper with the capacity of the Sun; gain from government and superiors; income does not fail.
Linked with the Sun, or Mars in H12: Mercury is never malefic; wife from a wealthy, sober family.
A planet (especially Saturn or Venus) in H7 makes it extremely benefic, particularly for a dark-complexioned native.
Alone with H7 empty: a royal combination but troubled; Moon in H7 leads to heavy eating and drinking.
Weak or afflicted Mercury: mischief and ill repute; in-laws and children suffer if the native drinks or eats non-vegetarian.
Green goods, trades and medical work do not pay for malefic Mercury; restless roaming in youth.

remedies.text: Keep away from the colour green.
Keep distance from the sister-in-law.

rows.theme: Knowledgeable, selfish, king-like; words and writing like jewels.

conditions.effect: Broad forehead, intelligent, long life, confident; Jupiter highly benefic; helps in-laws; conquers enemies.
H6 and H8 blank: sharp mind, firm determination, children troublesome but not denied.
Jupiter in H9 or H12 gives respect and a long-lived mother; Saturn in H6 gives self-made wealth.
Rahu or Ketu in H8 or H9 gives quick wit and sweet, forceful speech; Mars in H8/H9 gives profit from speech or a strong will.
Bundle of ash: father's earnings are lost, losses in gambling and speculation; father may die at 16-21 or 34-46.
Venus in H3/8/9/12, or rearing a sheep or parrot, harms the first wife and home.
Jupiter in H8, or Moon and Saturn in H12: relations and grandfather suffer, family wealth wasted 17 to 35.

remedies.text: Serve maidens; take help of Moon and Jupiter remedies.
Donate Moon items (rice, silver, milk) during the 17-35 age loss.
Avoid rearing parrot or sheep.

rows.theme: Extremely malefic for others; the native survives.

conditions.effect: At least 80 years; relatives help; wealthy and victorious; Mars in H1 or Sun in H11 makes Mercury benefic.
H9 and H11 empty: all-round benefic; Venus alive helps Ketu and Moon, with good writing.
Weak Mercury: quarrels with relatives, unproductive spending, settling away from the ancestral place; moong dal is a cause of illness.
A planet in H3, 4, 5, 9 or 11 hurts Ketu's relatives; a south-facing door gives H8 results.
Venus in H4 delays progeny; Moon in H8 with no friends in H6 hurts Venus, Saturn, Rahu; Rahu-Ketu-Saturn in H6/H7 costs father's wealth.

remedies.text: Clean teeth daily with alum.
Soak whole moong overnight and feed it to birds in the morning for 43 days.
Wash dhak leaves with milk and bury them in a quiet pit covered with stone; do not bring the digging tools home.
Serve green lentils to birds; donate Mercury items; keep a dog.

rows.note: Source's nose-piercing remedy omitted (body modification). Goat donation and burning shells omitted.

rows.theme: Royal combination; mother's life and wealth flow.

conditions.effect: Alone, Mercury turns companion planets to gold; Moon in H2 or in H3/H6 gives bountiful wealth and parental bliss.
Sun-Moon in H3, H5 or H11 with Jupiter in H9: no evil planet works; wealth, family and age excellent.
Benefic Jupiter gives royal prosperity and help from government.
Live Mercury things (parrot, sheep, goat) at home endanger the mother; family wealth falters.
Venus, Rahu or Saturn in H2, 5, 9, 12 (Father's Debt) or Moon in H6: males suffer, loss of female wealth, despair.

remedies.text: Silver chain for peace of mind; gold chain for wealth.
Saffron tilak or eating saffron for 43 days.
Use Sun remedies for malefic Mercury and Jupiter remedies for wealth.

conditions.effect: Prophetic speech; Sun, Moon, Jupiter in H3 or H9 give wealth and comfort after 34.
Dormant Mercury (H aspect blank): humane, good ancestral house, family life and progeny.
Moon in H1, 2, 4, 6 or 12 lets Mercury control the harm of planets in H4, 6-9.
Malefic Mercury hurts H1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9 unless Moon or Jupiter sit in H3 or H9; unfavourable for father but not children; own words cause loss.
Weak Moon or Jupiter, especially Moon before Mercury, gives Mercury's evil results.

remedies.text: Wear a copper coin with a hole on a thread around the neck.
Keep pearls and silver.

rows.theme: An unknown yogi, king at heart; kind words help, greed harms.

conditions.effect: Forceful speech, self-made wealth, gains by voyage and honest business; lawsuits go in his favour; Mercury follows other benefic planets (especially in H2) and doubles their good.
Alone and unaspected: printing, paper and Moon items profit; Sun, Jupiter or Saturn in H1 is a royal combination.
Greed; a north-facing house is inauspicious; a daughter married to the north is unhappy; mother may die or suffer around 34.
Mars in H4 or H8, or Venus in H4 with malefic Ketu, or Moon-Jupiter in H2: early death of mother, children after 34, bad eyesight.

remedies.text: Propitiate the Moon; wear gold; wife wears a silver ring on the left hand.
When Venus is malefic, bury a bottle of Ganges water under farmland; when Mercury is malefic, bury a milk container in a forest.

rows.theme: Good for others; alive is a diamond, dormant is malefic.

conditions.effect: Alive Mercury helps other planets; comfortable old age; Venus items help; indulging the wife helps.
Moon in H1 brings gain by sea voyage; Saturn in H3 makes in-laws rich; a planet in H1 and H10 neutralises malefics.
Sister, aunt and sister-in-law lead troubled lives; defamation through the sister-in-law.
Ketu in H1 or H8, H1 empty, or Jupiter in H9: loss in business or childhood trouble, but comfortable old age; Venus malefic until 34.
Mars in H1, 7 or 8, or Moon in H7, obstruct; troubled until 34 but business stays good.

remedies.text: Serve (feed and care for) a black cow that is handicapped.

rows.theme: Disease, blame and trap; honour and wealth at risk.

conditions.effect: With a male planet (Sun, Mars, Jupiter) or Mars in H12, Mercury is not malefic; Sun in H4 or a benefic Moon washes off its poison.
Alone it can make one learned and intelligent; Mars with it gives excellent results.
Health trouble in teeth and intestines; sudden losses, punishment without fault, half the wealth lost; 34th year troublesome.
H2 blank: bad 34 years, father's age and wealth hurt at 16-21; a planet in H2 poisons further.
Changing the place of worship or the stairs raises malefic effect; transit through H8 in the annual chart is very malefic.

remedies.text: Around the birthday (34 days before and after, and a day either side), bury an earthen bowl of honey in a forest.
Throw a copper pot of moong dal into a river within 34 to 42 days of the birthday.
Keep rain water or milk on the roof; avoid red clothes.
Worship the Goddess; serve maidens; wash yellow clothes; wear silver; donate mushrooms in an earthen pot at a temple; flow whole moong in a sealed copper pot.
For Moon in H2: give 24 sugarless milk-sweet cakes to a dog or float them in water; similar donation for another planet in H2.

rows.note: Remedies using kohl on the hips, a nose ring for a daughter, and Sun items to Saturn animals (buffalo, fish) omitted. Debilitation table in source not stored.

rows.theme: A king and a leper: mysterious birth, benefit depends on companions.

conditions.effect: Moon, Ketu and Jupiter in H1, 3, 6, 7 or 11 make Mercury benefic: lucky, wealthy, religious, big family.
Troublesome years 1, 4, 13, 15, 17, 28, 34; father suffers; after 34 acts like negative Mars; Mars or Sun malefic.
Alone: unfaithful, taking charms from a fakir brings misery; H1 blank gives a quarrelsome nature.
Jupiter alone in H6, 8 or 10 gives about 64 years and wife and progeny suffer.
Moon-Ketu in H11 gives a deceitful, vice-prone person.

remedies.text: Keep a red-coated round iron ball on you.
Wear yellow cloth washed in river water by day; do not wear green.
Bury silver under the house floor; feed a cow.
Donate mushrooms in an earthen pot at a temple for favour of superiors.
Flow rice and dal in water.
Do not accept charms or ash, keep idols, basil plants, parrots or goats; do not keep brass utensils empty or inverted.

rows.note: Source's nose-piercing remedy omitted (body modification). Table of which planet Mercury destroys by position not stored.

rows.theme: Subservient to Saturn; either twice benefic or twice malefic.

conditions.effect: H2 empty: gain through voyages; benefic H2 doubles money flow; benefic Saturn makes Mercury excellent.
Skilful, musical, wealthy; Moon in H1, 3, 4, 5 gives lion-house effect (arms dealing profits but family suffers).
Liquor or heavy eating turns Saturn malefic: ruin until 43; father's life and sight at risk.
H8 malefic doubles the trouble and may harm eyesight.

remedies.text: Propitiate Saturn; keep sober conduct.

rows.theme: Rich since birth but troubled until 34, a diamond after.

conditions.effect: After 34 wealth and comfort; condition decided by Jupiter; H2 empty: skilful and respected.
Transiting H1 in the annual chart (ages 11, 23, 36, 48, 57...) brings big gain.
Foolish and unlucky before 34; Moon, Saturn and Jupiter results poor until then.
Accepting a charm from a fakir when Mercury from H9 comes to H11 is destructive.

remedies.text: Wear a copper coin around the neck; keep a red iron ball.
Float any charm at home in water.

rows.theme: Long, comfortable life but peace is disturbed in transit; destroyer of H2,3,4,6,9,12.

conditions.effect: Jupiter or Saturn in H2 or H12 give honour, wealth and family; Jupiter and Saturn together in H7 (Fish Line) make Mercury excellent.
With Ketu's support, wealth and progeny grow.
Changeable and obstinate; trouble begins with drinking; loss in speculation and air travel agents; wife troubled; marriage at 25 hurts wife and father.
Planets in H6 are destroyed; Sun or Mars in H6: early death of mother; Jupiter in H6: father's wealth lost; Moon, Rahu or Saturn in H6, 5 or 2 bring particular harm.

remedies.text: Worship Lord Ganesh; do not drink; be truthful and calm.
Wear a gold ring or a jointless iron or platinum ring (not received free); saffron or turmeric tilak.
Throw an empty earthen pot in running water; feed three street dogs.
Worship daily at a temple to offset an empty H2.
